programs.description: Ummer, a kind labourer, works for the greater good and helps everyone. He vows to protect the poor from an evil businessman who engages in illegal businesses.
Veerabhadran is a chieftain of a tribal group who goes to any extent to help his people. However, he soon realises that the enemy is within his tribe.
Two friends, Nandakumar and Shashank, are in a desperate need of money. They decide to get their hands on some cash through unfair means.
While George's first love disappoints him, Malar, a college lecturer, restores his faith in love. His romantic journey takes him through several stages and helps him find his purpose.
Two brothers, both moneylenders, hate each other and extend their mutual hatred to their families as well. However, they face several obstacles that intensify after their estrangement.
Alice, a young teacher, is in love with Captain Thomas. However, Thomas suspects that Alice is having an illicit affair with Ravi, one of her students.
Hariharan, a builder, constructs a house for a wealthy man, who does not pay him. However, chaos ensues when he falls in love with the man's daughter.
Rival fishermen Esthappan and Anto set aside differences when their shared passion for theatre opens doors to experiences beyond their everyday lives.
Rajan is in love with his cousin Sumithra, and he tries many ways to ruin her marriage proposals. However, he is in for a rude shock when a man gets ready to marry her even after blackmailing him.
A dynastic struggle between the collateral branches of the Kuru clan, the Kauravas and Pandavas, for the throne of Hastinapur leads to the Kurukshetra War.
A patriarch of a royal family goes on a mission to find the murderers responsible for killing his descendant. He takes the help of his nephews who are police officers.
